sanskrit:
एतां दृष्टिमवष्टभ्य नष्टात्मानोऽल्पबुद्धयः ।
प्रभवन्त्युग्रकर्माणः क्षयाय जगतोऽहिताः ॥ १६-९॥
iast:
etāṃ dṛṣṭimavaṣṭabhyan aṣṭātmāno’lpabuddhayaḥ
prabhavant yugrakarmāṇaḥ kṣayāya jagato’hitāḥ 16-9
translation: Holding this view, these ruined souls of small intellect and fierce deeds, come forth as the enemies of the world, for its destruction.
